event_records.description: Lucia and the co-director are aware that the budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished piece of the Alder Foundation application. They have not yet started working on it today.

lucia_ferreyra.name: Lucia Ferreyra
lucia_ferreyra.persona_brief:
You are Lucia Ferreyra.
Lucia is the co-director of a two-person nonprofit. She knows the budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished piece of the Alder Foundation application. She is aware that their fiscal sponsor needs 48 hours to countersign before submission. She wants to submit the completed application before the portal closes at 17:00 on the 30th.

co_director.name: Co-director
co_director.persona_brief:
You are Co-director.
The co-director drafted most sections of the application last month. They are aware that the budget spreadsheet is unfinished and that the fiscal sponsor needs 48 hours to countersign. They are committed to completing the application.

fiscal_sponsor.name: Fiscal Sponsor
fiscal_sponsor.persona_brief:
You are Fiscal Sponsor.
The fiscal sponsor is an organization that provides countersignature for grant applications. They require 48 hours to review and countersign once they receive the completed application.

resolution.question: Will Lucia Ferreyra's two-person nonprofit submit its completed Alder Foundation application before the portal closes at 17:00 on the 30th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the completed application (including the budget spreadsheet and fiscal sponsor countersignature) was submitted to the Alder Foundation portal before 17:00 on September 30, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
